steps.en: Page shows five boxes for notice numbers
steps.id: Halaman menampilkan lima kotak nomor notice

steps.en: Each notice number is checked for format and duplicates
steps.id: Tiap nomor notice dicek format dan duplikatnya

steps.en: Payment reference numbers can be typed in too
steps.id: Nomor payment reference juga bisa diketik
steps.why_en: Only notice-format numbers pass; payment reference numbers are rejected.
steps.why_id: Hanya nomor berformat notice yang lolos; nomor payment reference ditolak.

steps.en: Up to five numbers go out in one search
steps.id: Sampai lima nomor dikirim dalam satu pencarian

steps.en: All searched notices come back together
steps.id: Semua notice yang dicari kembali bersamaan

steps.en: Several notices can be selected and paid together
steps.id: Beberapa notice bisa dipilih dan dibayar sekaligus
steps.why_en: The payment gateway is outside the code we can see.
steps.why_id: Gateway pembayaran ada di luar code yang bisa dilihat.
